status: complete proposed wording; language review required before integration
catalogue_terms: pinenta (image), Dinanña’ i pinenta siha (Image assembly), mapega (placed), RAM. The output image is named as the image generated from the assembly, not merely the last image.
remaining_contextual_holds: Tap workspace sequence: establish the painted target and natural Chamorro gesture terms before accepting.
No attachment fits: verify phrasing for a placement target under coordinate bounds.
Decoded output: distinguish decoded image buffers from file size and separate estimated editing/render memory.

entries.source: An assembly can contain up to 20 images. Remove an image to add another.
entries.wording: Siña u guaha asta 20 na pinenta gi un dinanña' i pinenta siha. Na'suha un pinenta para un na'hålum un ottru.
entries.decision: Remove one before adding a new image.

entries.source: An assembly can contain up to 20 images.
entries.wording: Siña u guaha asta 20 na pinenta gi un dinanña' i pinenta siha.
entries.decision: Short variant is a limit only; no advice appended.

entries.source: An image cannot attach to itself or one of its attached images.
entries.wording: Ti siña ma'achetta un pinenta gi maisa gui' pat gi un pinenta ni esta ma'achetta guiya.
entries.decision: Self and its attached child are forbidden; not a general ban on attaching two images.

entries.source: AN Paint assembly image
entries.wording: AN Paint · Pinenta gi dinanña' i pinenta siha
entries.decision: Drag label represents a source image within assembly, not rendered output.

entries.source: AN Paint · Image assembly\n%1$s/20 images · %2$s placed
entries.wording: AN Paint · Dinanña' i pinenta siha\n%1$s/20 pinenta · %2$s mapega
entries.decision: Keep total before placed count; both counts are supplied already formatted.

entries.source: Assembly output size
entries.wording: Mineddung i pinenta ni para u mafa'tinas ginin i dinanña'
entries.decision: Name the generated composite, not the size of the workspace or source image.

entries.source: Assembly.png
entries.wording: Dinanña.png
entries.decision: Default filename; keep extension, prefer no quote or spaces.

entries.source: Create output
entries.wording: Fa'tinas i pinenta ginin i dinanña'
entries.decision: Button generates the composite; no implication of immediate save.

entries.source: Cropped thumbnail: %1$s
entries.wording: Dikiki' na mostra ni ma'utot: %1$s
entries.decision: The accessibility image name belongs after the marker; distinction from normal thumbnail.

entries.source: Drag placed images to move them. Hold and drag a thumbnail to add it.
entries.wording: Go'ti yan muebi i pinenta siha ni mapega para un tulaika i lugåt-ñiha. Go'ti yan muebi un dikiki' na mostra para un na'hålum i pinenta.
entries.decision: Distinguish changing position from adding the source represented by its thumbnail.

entries.source: Image placed. Drag it to move, or hold and drag another thumbnail.
entries.wording: Mapega i pinenta. Go'ti yan muebi para un tulaika i lugåt-ña, pat go'ti yan muebi un ottru na dikiki' na mostra.
entries.decision: Placement status followed by separate move/add affordances.

entries.source: Image thumbnails and filenames. Scroll horizontally for more.
entries.wording: Dikiki' na mostran pinenta siha yan na'an i dokumentu siha. Muebi i lista gi banda para un li'e' mås.
entries.decision: Explicit sideways movement of the list, not dragging an individual image.

entries.source: Invalid image attachments.
entries.wording: Ti balidu i inachetton pinenta siha.
entries.decision: Invalid placement relationships, not bad file format.

entries.source: Shows the whole assembly. Image and output sizes stay unchanged.
entries.wording: Mumostra todu i dinanña' i pinenta siha. Ti matulaika i mineddung i pinenta siha pat i mineddung i pinenta ni para u mafa'tinas.
entries.decision: Fit to view changes neither individual dimensions nor composite output dimensions.

entries.source: Sort tray
entries.wording: Na'arekla i bandehan dikiki' na mostran pinenta
entries.decision: Sort the source tray rather than reflowing the assembly; verify the tray noun with reviewer.

entries.source: Tap an image thumbnail first.
entries.wording: Patcha un dikiki' na mostran pinenta fine'na.
entries.decision: Tap an image thumbnail before the action; use the same term as the tray.

entries.source: The assembly exceeds Android\'s coordinate range.
entries.wording: I koordinådan i dinanña' i pinenta siha mås ki i limit ni ma sedi gi Android.
entries.decision: Specify coordinates, not memory, size, or position in an ordered list.

entries.source: The assembly needs about %1$s. Choose a smaller output size.
entries.wording: Makatkukula na ha nisisita i dinanña' %1$s na RAM. Atyik un mås dikiki' na mineddung para i pinenta ni para u mafa'tinas.
entries.decision: Use estimated memory, not just below the value ('kasi'); chooser changes the output only.

entries.source: The assembly output is unavailable. Reopen Image assembly and try again.
entries.wording: Ti siña mausa i pinenta ginin i dinanña'. Baba ta'lu «Dinanña' i pinenta siha» yan chagi ta'lu.
entries.decision: Don't infer that the file is missing; tell user to reopen the named tool.

entries.source: The attachment image is missing.
entries.wording: Malingu i pinenta ni ma usa para ma'achetta un ottru na pinenta.
entries.decision: Missing anchor image, not the dependent/attached one.

entries.source: The normalized image dimensions are outside Android\'s range.
entries.wording: I mineddung i pinenta siha ni manaparehu mås ki i limit ni ma sedi gi Android.
entries.decision: Dimensions after normalization, not total file size or count.

entries.source: Common width as a percentage of %1$d px
entries.wording: Parehu na finedda' kumu porsientu di %1$d px
entries.decision: Reference dimension as denominator rather than percentage inside the current field.

entries.source: Common height as a percentage of %1$d px
entries.wording: Parehu na attura kumu porsientu di %1$d px
entries.decision: Height counterpart; match the same denominator language.

entries.source: Exact position
entries.wording: Eksåktu na lugåt
entries.decision: Exact place; this control is not canvas alignment.

entries.source: Target X (pixels from left)
entries.wording: X (pixels disdi i akagui' na oriya)
entries.decision: From the left edge, not a direction to move toward.

entries.source: Target Y (pixels from top)
entries.wording: Y (pixels disdi i sanhilo' na oriya)
entries.decision: From the top edge; contrast with the X control.

entries.source: X and Y must be whole numbers from zero to 2147483647.
entries.wording: Debi na intiru na numiru siha i X yan Y, disdi seru asta 2147483647.
entries.decision: Whole numbers, inclusive endpoints. Do not add negative sign or separators.

entries.source: The selected image is no longer in this assembly.
entries.wording: I pinenta ni ma'atyik ti gaigi esta gi esti na dinanña' i pinenta siha.
entries.decision: Image is no longer in the current assembly, not necessarily deleted from storage.

entries.source: Give all images the same width. Number of images: %1$d. Each image keeps its own aspect ratio. Original files and crop settings stay unchanged.
entries.wording: Na'parehu i finedda' i todu i pinenta siha. Numirun pinenta: %1$d. Kada pinenta ha na'sahnguan i proporsion-ña. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu siha yan i inatyik para i inutot.
entries.decision: Each image preserves its own aspect ratio; preserve both original files and crop settings.

entries.source: Give all images the same height. Number of images: %1$d. Each image keeps its own aspect ratio. Original files and crop settings stay unchanged.
entries.wording: Na'parehu i attura i todu i pinenta siha. Numirun pinenta: %1$d. Kada pinenta ha na'sahnguan i proporsion-ña. Ti matulaika i urihinåt na dokumentu siha yan i inatyik para i inutot.
entries.decision: Same instruction for matching heights, not width or both dimensions.
